claim: Android's real DocumentsUI journey selected three media documents in one selection and imported all three; the drop caused by a stale preview registration invalidating an in-flight import is repaired.

verification.detail: The Android job built the case APKs and ran the SAF preview case on an API 36 x86_64 emulator; the case passed its import-count expectation (_untilMediaImports expected 3) where the previous revision imported 2, and then completed relink, export, recovery and bounded-resource checks.

limitations: Android evidence is from an API 36 x86_64 SwiftShader emulator, not a physical device.
The media is a small synthetic fixture; it does not establish performance with representative media.
The repair retries a registration refused as STALE_PREVIEW_REQUEST; the plugin's binding-epoch guard itself is unchanged and still refuses work a newer request replaced.
The previous revision 44f9e39 failed this same case with two of three imports, which is the regression this run verifies as repaired.
